name: resilience-patterns
description: Design resilient distributed services — circuit breaker, retry with backoff, timeout, bulkhead isolation, rate limiting, and fallback strategies. Use when asked about "circuit breaker", "retry logic", "timeouts", "cascading failures", "service keeps going down", "bulkhead", "rate limit", or "what happens when a dependency is slow/down". Do NOT use for: SLO target design — use `slo-design`.
